newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-JUVENTUS CRUSH PSG IN AWAY LEG OF SUPER CUP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-JUVENTUS CRUSH PSG IN AWAY LEG OF SUPER CUP.

text.p: Winger Michele Padovano scored twice as world club champions Juventus crushed Paris Saint-Germain 6-1 in the first leg of the European Super Cup on Wednesday.
Central defenders Sergio Porrini and Ciro Ferrara also scored as the Italians stormed into a four-goal halftime lead, making light of a treacherous Parc des Princes pitch with icy patches.
Substitutes Attilio Lombardo and Nicola Amoruso added further goals in the final eight minutes after Brazil's Rai had pulled one back for PSG with a penalty seven minutes into the second half.

Defender Laurent Fournier made an already dismal night for PSG worse when he was sent off just after the hour for a second bookable offence after kicking the ball at a prostrate opponent he had fouled seconds earlier.
It was the fifth successive Juventus victory over their French opponents in European competition and the third in a row at the Parc after two previous UEFA Cup wins in Paris.
The second leg in Turin and a second Super Cup since 1984 is now a formality for the European Cup holders.
